title: Bloom Energy (BE) Is Up 8.7% After Oracle Reaffirms 2.4 GW AI Fuel Cell Deal Commitment – Has The Bull Case Changed?
title_zh: Bloom Energy (BE) Is Up 8.7% After Oracle Reaffirms 2.4 GW AI Fuel Cell Deal Commitment – Has The Bull Case Changed?
summary: Earlier this week, Bloom Energy said Oracle remains committed to its roughly 2.4 GW fuel cell contract for the Project Jupiter AI data center despite issuing a force majeure notice tied to delays in the supporting natural gas pipeline.

title: Apollo’s Johnson & Johnson Deal Could Open a New Healthcare Growth Avenue
title_zh: Apollo’s Johnson & Johnson Deal Could Open a New Healthcare Growth Avenue
summary: It was reported on September 11 that Apollo Global Management, Inc. (NYSE:APO) is in discussions to acquire Johnson & Johnson (NYSE:JNJ)’s orthopedics business, DePuy Synthes, in a potential transaction valuing the unit at close to $20 billion, according to Bloomberg.
